Detail of what a qualified run must still establish: presence of an absolute local renderer path (chromium/google-chrome/headless_shell or a playwright/node install), a successful HTML->PNG render, exit status 0, PNG magic bytes 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A, and declared pixel dimensions.
